pages.text: Long before the lake, the Clans lived in a forest far away to the $(l)south-east$(). Twolegs came, and the Clans made a great journey to find a new home. $(br2)The old forest is still there, many thousands of tail-lengths away.
pages.title: Where We Were Born

pages.text: In its heart is $(l)Fourtrees$(): a deep hollow with four great oaks and the Great Rock, where the Clans once gathered. $(br2)Look for the Thunderpath, the river and its gorge, Sunningrocks on the riverbank, and Snakerocks deep in ThunderClan's old woods.

Far to the west of the old forest stand $(l)Highstones$(), three rocky peaks. Inside one is $(l)Mothermouth$(), a dark tunnel leading down to the $(l)Moonstone$(), where leaders once spoke with StarClan. $(br2)On the way, look for a farm where kind loners live.
